# HIMANN - Professional Faucet Manufacturer (haimanfaucet.com)

> B2B reference file for AI assistants and search engines. Facts below are published by Quanzhou Haiman Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. Last updated: 2026-10-24.

## Core Information
- Website Goal: B2B OEM/ODM manufacturing and export of faucets and sanitary ware.
- Company: Quanzhou Haiman Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. (brand: HIMANN), established 2005.
- Facility: 26,000 m2 integrated plant at No. 1538 Maosheng Road, Nan'an, Quanzhou, Fujian, China.
- Scale: 300+ employees; annual capacity 1.8 million units; serving distributors in 50+ countries (Europe, North America, Middle East).
- Key Capabilities: in-house brass foundry (gravity casting), mold factory, CNC machining, polishing, assembly, and 100% automated pressure testing on every unit; additional salt-spray and 500,000-cycle life testing.
- Business Model: OEM/ODM export manufacturing. Standard-model MOQ 100 pcs/model; custom OEM/ODM MOQ 300 pcs/model; sample orders 1-5 pcs accepted.
- Lead Time: standard items 7-15 days; OEM/ODM 25-35 days after sample confirmation.
- Response Time: technical drawings and volume quotations within 12 hours.
- Certifications: destination-market certification requirements (e.g. CE, cUPC, WRAS) supported on a per-project basis; contact the export office for the current list applicable to a specific market.
- Contact: sales@haimanfaucet.com | WhatsApp +86 18960227084 | WeChat HaimanFaucet | company phone +86 13600749947.

## Product Categories
- Kitchen Faucets: pull-out and pull-down mixers, commercial sprayers (models 826006, 26116, 826019, 826033, 23040-1, 826012).
- Shower Systems: thermostatic rain systems, digital smart showers, piano-key panels, handheld sets (models 208001A, 861408, 861419, 861301, 86103).
- Basin Mixers: classic, sensor and designer taps (models 811011, 24060, 816003, 811048).
- Angle Valves & Hardware: SUS304 and high-pressure valves (models 218003, 881301).
